family_title_en: Use the correct subject or verb

stages.ix_title: Use the correct subject or verb

what_to_do.en: Tap the subject or verb that matches.

stages.choice_rule: Four unique whole words from the wordlist or allowed_extra_words. Mix verb-gap and subject-gap items. Exactly one choice agrees. For a verb gap, include the opposite-number form of the same verb or be/have/do pair. For a subject gap, include real pronouns or nouns of the other number. Never write two choices that both make a good sentence.

gold_items.stem: The puppy and the cat ... milk.

roots: Keep four unique tap choices and exactly one right answer.
Every choice is a whole word from the wordlist or allowed_extra_words.
On verb-gap items, one distractor is the opposite-number form of the same verb or of is/are, was/were, has/have, do/does, or go/goes.
On subject-gap items, distractors are real pronouns or nouns that do not agree with the given verb.
Never include two choices that both make a correct sentence, such as He and She with climbs.
Tier 1 may use far helpers. Tier 3 uses the nearest noun or ignores and.
Capitalize subject choices that fill a stem start. Keep verb choices lowercase.
Stay in kid world: school, home, food, pets, play, family, weather. No brands.

tier_rules.1: Short stems of four to six words. One clear person or group. Far helpers such as are or have with a singular noun. Add a lemma picture on the noun.
tier_rules.2: Stems of five to eight words with two-syllable nouns. Use the true opposite pair such as has/have or swim/swims, plus two extra wrong forms.
tier_rules.3: Near misses: compound subjects with and, a noun beside the gap that tempts the wrong number, or <NAME> as one person with goes, has, is, or a verb with s.

verb_singular.en: He, she, it, or one name takes is, was, has, does, goes, or a verb with s.
verb_singular.ko: he, she, it 또는 이름 하나에는 is, was, has, does, goes나 s가 있는 동사를 씁니다.

verb_plural.en: I, you, we, they, or more than one take are, were, have, do, go, or a verb with no s.
verb_plural.ko: I, you, we, they 또는 둘 이상에는 are, were, have, do, go나 s가 없는 동사를 씁니다.

subject_singular.en: This verb is for one. Tap he, she, it, or one name.
subject_singular.ko: 이 동사는 하나에 맞습니다. he, she, it 또는 이름 하나를 누르세요.

subject_plural.en: This verb is for more than one. Tap I, you, we, they, or a group.
subject_plural.ko: 이 동사는 둘 이상에 맞습니다. I, you, we, they 또는 여럿을 누르세요.

compound_and.en: Two subjects joined by and need a plural verb, like need, are, or have.
compound_and.ko: and로 이어진 두 주어에는 need, are, have처럼 복수 동사를 씁니다.
